blockers: PENTPRIM PORT (precisely enumerated): 232 unique unresolved symbols = the complete assembly-only rasterizer surface. Classification: 169 TriangleRender_* variants (Z/ZI/ZIF Z-buffered flat+lit families; ZPT* perspective-correct textured families with subdivision thresholds 32-1024; I8-palette and RGB555/565/888 high-colour targets; TIA/TPD decal variants) + 63 support symbols (LineRender PI/PII/PIT/PIZ2 lines incl. per-format, RasteriseBuffer*, safediv/sar16/decal helpers). Full list: builds/pentprim-c-port-surface.txt. The XOBJS_C generic path covers only perspective-math support (awtm/l_pi/p_pi/persp/frcp/rcp/dither); all actual rasterizers are asm-only.

PRIMITIVE LIBRARY (root cause, precisely scoped): softrend rendererNew requires a primitive library (BrPrimitiveLibraryFind); the period source ships exactly one - pentprim - split 8 C framework files vs 60 x86 assembly rasterizer objects. Headless ZB completion therefore requires either a C reimplementation of a minimal float primitive subset (ZB triangle, RGB_888+DEPTH_16) registered under the Default-Primitives-Float name, or porting the pentium assembly pipelines. This is THE remaining rendering wall; everything upstream (softrend build, registration, facility find) is proven.
